description: One voice agent, identified by its platform's own id. Written as agents/<id>.yaml.

id.description: Alias used everywhere else in sopc: the file name without .yaml. Set automatically.
id.title: Id

livekit.description: LiveKit agent_name. Set exactly one of livekit, vapi, elevenlabs.
livekit.title: Livekit

vapi.description: Vapi assistant id. Set exactly one of livekit, vapi, elevenlabs.
vapi.title: Vapi

elevenlabs.description: ElevenLabs agent_id. Set exactly one of livekit, vapi, elevenlabs.
elevenlabs.title: Elevenlabs

inherits.description: Base ids to include, in order. Their parents come first.
inherits.title: Inherits

exclude.description: Ids of bases or SOPs that target this agent but shouldn't apply. Locked ones can't be excluded.
exclude.title: Exclude

variables.description: Values for {{name}} placeholders. Override the defaults in sopc.yaml.
variables.title: Variables

instructions.description: Text only this agent gets, rendered after the top bases and before the SOPs.
instructions.title: Instructions

title: sopc agent: agents/<id>.yaml
